errors.text_span: There are nine bars, each corresponding to a different clinical specialty.
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart with 6 groups of bars on the x-axis. Each group contains 7 bars, for a total of 42 bars, not nine. The description fundamentally misunderstands the structure of the chart.
The description completely omits the grouped nature of the bar chart. It fails to explain that the x-axis categories are groups of 7 bars each, which is a critical structural feature.

errors.text_span: The “Cardio” bar has a value of approximately -23.4, the “Gastro” bar has a value of approximately -23.6, and the “Pediatrics” bar has a value of approximately -23.2.
errors.evidence: There are no single bars named “Cardio”, “Gastro”, or “Pediatrics”. These are labels for the groups of bars on the x-axis. The description invents non-existent data points by treating the group labels as individual bars.

errors.text_span: while the orange bars represent models fine-tuned on Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, respectively.
errors.evidence: The legend shows six distinct colors for the fine-tuned models, ranging from a very light beige/orange to a dark brown. Grouping them all as 'the orange bars' is an oversimplification and inaccurate.

errors.text_span: All other bars represent values between -25.8 and -23.8.
errors.evidence: This range is incorrect. The full range of values in the chart is from approximately -27 to -22. Numerous bars fall outside the narrow range stated in the description, such as the base model bar for 'Cardio' terms at -27, or the Cardio-tuned model bar for 'Cardio' terms at -22.
The description fails to mention the label for the horizontal axis, which is 'Per-specialty terms'.
